headline: Devils acquire Hellebuyck from Devils in deal involving Mercer, Daws
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Devils have acquired Hellebuyck in a deal involving Mercer and Daws, a move that came on the day his suspension for failing to report to training camp was set to lapse. The headline lists the Devils on both sides of the trade, so the report as given doesn't make clear who went where.

What the numbers say is that NJD has a goaltending problem to solve. Goals saved above expected, which compares a goalie's saves to what an average goalie would make against the same shots, sits at minus 5.3 for the team so far this season. Goals minus expected, the gap between goals scored and the quality of chances taken, is minus 3.4. The Devils are 6-4-0 with 12 points, so the record is holding up better than the finishing and the saves.

The skaters are doing their part. NJD owns 58.6% of the expected goals, a measure of chance quality, and 60% at five-on-five. That is a team creating the better chances most nights. Fix the goaltending and the results should move toward what the chances suggest, which is why a goalie addition matters here more than most.
